answer_text:
Here is a comprehensive guide to getting **free satellite radio** in 2026:

---

## 🛰️ Free Satellite Radio Options

### 1. 🚗 **Free Trial with a New Car**
If you just drove off the lot in a shiny new car, chances are that SiriusXM Satellite Radio is a standard feature on your radio and free of charge for a certain period of time. If you just bought a new car, chances are you have SiriusXM for free for three months.

---

### 2. 📡 **SiriusXM Free 3-Month In-Car Trial**
You can start a free 3-month trial subscription from SiriusXM, getting every channel, including every premium channel, plus access inside and outside the car and on the app.

- The car satellite radio option will ask for a VIN, but that's it.
- This offer is available only on qualifying inactive radios as determined solely by SiriusXM.

---

### 3. 📱 **SiriusXM Free 3-Month Streaming Trial**
You can also get 3 months free of SiriusXM Streaming, a $29.97 value. While the in-car offer gives you satellite radio in your car, the streaming offer gives you the same radio accessible on your phone, tablet, and computer.

- The streaming option will ask for a credit card, but it won't charge you until the 3 months is over.

---

### 4. 🎧 **What You Get with the Free Trials**
Both offers give you hundreds of channels of ad-free music curated by genre, era, and even artist-inspired channels. You'll also have access to live sports – including MLB, NFL, NBA, NHL, NASCAR, & college sports – plus original talk shows, news coverage, interviews, podcasts, and much more.

---

### 5. 🔁 **Periodic Free Listening Events**
SiriusXM occasionally offers completely free listening windows. For example, SiriusXM was free from May 21 – June 1, letting you listen to great music, sports analysis, comedy and more — no subscription needed during that window.

---

### 6. 💡 **Why Satellite Radio Over Streaming?**
There are a whole lot of places in the country where streaming services just don't work. If you're out in the middle of nowhere, you'll be disappointed if you rely solely on streaming services. You can start in California and end up in Massachusetts and listen to the same SiriusXM channel from coast to coast with barely an interruption, because it's satellite-based and the whole country is covered.

---

### 📝 Tips to Stay Free Longer:
- **Cancel before the trial ends** to avoid being charged.
- **Watch for free listening weekends** — SiriusXM runs these periodically throughout the year.
- There are also discount programs that can get you free access for a limited period of time.

---

**To get started**, visit [siriusxm.com/free-trial](https://www.siriusxm.com/free-trial) or check your car's radio for an existing trial offer.
